    Distance-based model building blocks

    permanovaprimer.Rd

    Utilities for validated distance algebra, canonical mixed-design compilation, fixed and balanced random-intercept PERMANOVA inference, explicit fixed-by-random interaction EMS, balanced nested random-intercept inference, canonical crossed randomized-block permutation inference, and reproducible validation. Design-aware dispersion inference retains pseudo-Euclidean axes and uses validated balanced EMS and exchangeability structures. Balanced crossed-nested hybrids add exact treatment-by-region denominators and intact treatment-profile permutations. Unbalanced fixed models add estimable Type I, II, and III hypotheses with term-specific residual permutations. Unequally replicated random-intercept models add cluster-weighted centroids and size-stratified whole-cluster empirical inference. Unbalanced nested and randomized-block models add topology- or block-by-size-restricted unit-centroid permutations. One-factor planned and pairwise centroid contrasts add contrast-specific residual permutations and explicit multiplicity adjustment. Lower-level unbalanced nested models add parent-adjusted child-centroid or child-adjusted observation inference with level-specific restricted residual permutations. Unbalanced crossed-nested hybrids add equal-site-weight complete profile centroids, additive region adjustment, and region-by-topology empirical permutations without claiming an unbalanced EMS denominator. Balanced complete two-condition repeated measures add correlated random intercept–slope trace covariance and whole-subject sign-flip inference under an explicit central-symmetry assumption. Exact unique-assignment audits use non-overlapping seed batches to harden unequal-random-intercept calibration. Full-rank categorical fixed models add explicitly weighted marginal means and general-linear planned or pairwise contrasts. Balanced mixed designs add planned and pairwise experimental-unit contrasts with design-specific residual or interaction denominators. Fixed one-factor contrast families add shared global-null maximum-statistic adjustment with explicitly weak familywise error control. Full-rank fixed models containing ordinary numeric covariates add contrasts at explicit reference values with declared categorical nuisance weighting. Supported mixed designs add shared raw experimental-unit maximum-statistic adjustment with explicitly weak complete-treatment-null familywise control. Fixed one-factor all-pair complete-distribution equality hypotheses add intersection-specific connected-component label permutation and closed-test strong familywise control. This proof does not cover centroid equality under heterogeneous distributions. A capability registry consolidates the validated design, estimand, denominator, permutation, error-control, and exclusion contracts.

    Arguments

    x, distance

    A dist object or full numeric distance matrix.

    tol

    Numerical tolerance.

    X

    A numeric design matrix.

    formula

    A model formula.

    data

    A data frame in distance-matrix row order.

    design

    A canonical design produced by compile_permanova_design.

    term

    The sole categorical fixed main-effect term for dispersion inference.

    terms

    Optional fixed-effect terms to derive or test.

    level

    Detected or explicitly requested lower nested assignment level.

    hypothesis

    Requested Type I, II, or III fixed-effect hypothesis.

    contrasts

    Numeric one-factor contrast vector, row matrix, or named list.

    adjust

    Multiplicity adjustment for a contrast family.

    factor

    Target categorical predictor for marginal means or contrasts.

    weights

    Equal reference-grid or observed-frequency nuisance weighting.

    at

    Named finite reference values for every numeric nuisance covariate.

    type

    Whether dispersion is measured from group spatial medians or centroids.

    bias_adjust

    Whether to apply the equal-group-size small-sample adjustment.

    group

    A grouping factor.

    permutations

    A non-negative number of random permutations, or "all" for exhaustive enumeration where supported.

    seed

    An optional random seed.

    engine

    The one-way calculation engine.

    keep_permutations

    Whether to retain permutation statistics.

    max_exact

    Maximum permutation space to enumerate exactly.

    max_intersections

    Maximum closed intersection family allowed by the computational guard.

    numerator_ems, denominator_ems

    Numerator and candidate denominator EMS coefficients.

    mean_squares, dfs

    Candidate mean squares and degrees of freedom.

    truncate

    Whether to report a zero-truncated variance-component sensitivity analysis.

    assume_additive

    Whether to explicitly assume omitted fixed-by-random interaction variances are zero.

    p_method

    Whether to calculate no p-value, an opt-in Satterthwaite approximation, or a canonical crossed permutation p-value.

    groups_per_treatment, group_counts

    Numbers of whole plots in simulations or benchmarks.

    replicates

    Observations per whole plot.

    response_variables

    Number of simulated community dimensions.

    effect

    Simulated location-shift magnitude.

    cluster_sd, residual_sd

    Simulation standard deviations.

    dispersion_ratio

    Impact/control residual standard-deviation ratio.

    simulations

    Simulations per validation scenario.

    batches, simulations_per_batch

    Independent calibration batches and null datasets per batch.

    engine_checks

    Number of audited datasets also passed through the exhaustive full distance engine.

    blocks

    Number of random blocks in crossed-interaction validation.

    regions_per_treatment, sites_per_region

    Numbers of top-level and nested units in nested validation.

    regions, sites

    Numbers of regions and sites per region in hybrid validation.

    interaction_sd, block_sd

    Generating standard deviations for crossed-interaction validation.

    region_sd, site_sd

    Generating standard deviations for nested validation.

    parent_sd, child_sd

    Generating standard deviations for unbalanced nested validation.

    nested_interaction_sd

    Generating treatment-by-nested-site standard deviation.

    alpha

    Simulation rejection threshold.

    keep_results

    Whether to retain iteration-level simulation results.

    include_vegan

    Whether to compare with vegan::adonis2 when installed.

    Value

    The distance utilities return matrices or projection metadata. Model functions return structured S3 result or design objects.
